shortDescription: The Brand Hero section creates dedicated header areas for brand or manufacturer landing pages. It combines a prominent brand logo with heading and description text to introduce the brand to visitors. Background styles range from dark and light solid colors to custom images, automatically adjusting text colors for readability. This section helps establish brand identity within the store while maintaining visual consistency with the overall theme.
